# Ganga (Merina) Bishwakarma

> Creator, founder, and caretaker from Damak, Nepal. Fashion and content creator,
> founder of Mery El's jewellery, co-founder of Mery and Khem Studio, and part of
> the Hunate movement. Real life, honestly shared.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.gangabishwakarma.com.np/): Her story and journey, from the stage to caregiving to building Mery El's and the studio.
- [Mery El's](https://www.gangabishwakarma.com.np/meryels/): Her 18K gold plated jewellery brand. Order via Instagram and WhatsApp.
- [Mery and Khem Studio](https://www.gangabishwakarma.com.np/studio/): A creative studio in Damak across brand, digital, and life, co-founded with Khem Raj Pradhan.
- [My Picks](https://www.gangabishwakarma.com.np/affiliates/): Honest affiliate product recommendations, mostly from Daraz.
